all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُواْ لَوۡ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةࣰ فَنَتَبَرَّأَ مِنۡهُمۡ كَمَا تَبَرَّءُواْ مِنَّاۗ كَذَٰلِكَ يُرِيهِمُ ٱللَّهُ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ حَسَرَٰتٍ عَلَيۡهِمۡۖ وَمَا هُم بِخَٰرِجِينَ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ

translations.saheeh: Those who followed will say, "If only we had another turn [at worldly life] so we could disassociate ourselves from them as they have disassociated themselves from us." Thus will Allah show them their deeds as regrets upon them. And they are never to emerge from the Fire.
translations.pickthall: And those who were but followers will say: If a return were possible for us, we would disown them even as they have disowned us. Thus will Allah show them their own deeds as anguish for them, and they will not emerge from the Fire.
translations.khattab: The ˹misled˺ followers will cry, “If only we could have a second chance, we would disown them as they disowned us.” And so Allah will make them remorseful of their misdeeds. And they will never ˹be able to˺ leave the Fire
translations.arberry: and those that followed say, 'O if only we might return again and disown them, as they have disowned us!' Even so God shall show them their works. O bitter regrets for them! Never shall they issue from the Fire.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ رَدَدۡنَا لَكُمُ ٱلۡكَرَّةَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَأَمۡدَدۡنَٰكُم بِأَمۡوَٰلࣲ وَبَنِينَ وَجَعَلۡنَٰكُمۡ أَكۡثَرَ نَفِيرًا

translations.saheeh: Then We gave back to you a return victory over them. And We reinforced you with wealth and sons and made you more numerous in manpower
translations.pickthall: Then we gave you once again your turn against them, and We aided you with wealth and children and made you more in soldiery.
translations.khattab: Then ˹after your repentance˺ We would give you the upper hand over them and aid you with wealth and offspring, causing you to outnumber them
translations.arberry: Then We gave back to you the turn to prevail over them, and We succoured you with wealth and children, and We made you a greater host.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَلَوۡ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةࣰ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

translations.saheeh: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers... "
translations.pickthall: Oh, that we had another turn (on earth), that we might be of the believers!
translations.khattab: If only we could have a second chance, then we would be believers.”
translations.arberry: O that we might return again, and be among the believers!'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَوۡ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرَى ٱلۡعَذَابَ لَوۡ أَنَّ لِي كَرَّةࣰ فَأَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ

translations.saheeh: Or [lest] it say when it sees the punishment, "If only I had another turn so I could be among the doers of good."
translations.pickthall: Or should say, when it seeth the doom: Oh, that I had but a second chance that I might be among the righteous!
translations.khattab: Or say, upon seeing the torment, ‘If only I had a second chance, I would have been one of the good-doers.’
translations.arberry: it should say, when it sees the chastisement, 'O that I might return again, and be among the good-doers.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ ٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيۡنِ يَنقَلِبۡ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ خَاسِئࣰ ا وَهُوَ حَسِيرࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.
translations.pickthall: Then look again and yet again, thy sight will return unto thee weakened and made dim.
translations.khattab: Then look again and again—your sight will return frustrated and weary
translations.arberry: Then return thy gaze again, and again, and thy gaze comes back to thee dazzled, aweary.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ تِلۡكَ إِذࣰ ا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."
translations.pickthall: They say: Then that would be a vain proceeding.
translations.khattab: Adding, “Then such a return would be a ˹total˺ loss ˹for us˺!”
translations.arberry: They shall say, 'That then were a losing return!'
